Office of the First Lady
The White HouseNovember 12, 2026
The First Lady of the United States of America, Mrs. Melania Trump, participated in a wreath-laying ceremony at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier at Arlington National Cemetery on Veterans Day.
The First Lady reflected on the experience:
“Every time I visit the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, I use the surrounding calmness to reflect on our nation’s military. Yesterday’s visit was no different.
I think about the Americans who gave their lives defending our freedom. I think about their families, their loved ones, and the lives America’s Unknown Soldiers never had a chance to experience. We lost fathers, mothers, innovators, leaders of justice, athletes, musicians, and so much more.
The Tomb of the Unknown Soldier is also important because it represents the diversity of our nation. Brave Americans from every background, race, and religion served in the name of freedom. Together, these unknown souls are forever united by their ultimate commitment to our country.
The soldiers who guard the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, every hour of every day, year after year, are highly dedicated individuals. They refuse to abandon their fallen brothers and sisters. Let these individuals inspire our children about the core value of American commitment.
I will always remember the sacrifice of our Unknown Soldiers. They gave their lives for all of us, and for future generations of Americans.”

item.title: Joint Statement on an Agreement Between the United States of America and the Kingdom of Thailand on Reciprocal Trade
item.description:

The White HouseNovember 17, 2026
On November 17, 2026, in Manila, Philippines, President Donald J. Trump and Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul confirmed that the United States of America (“the United States”) and the Kingdom of Thailand (“Thailand”) have reached substantial conclusion in their negotiations for anAgreement Between the United States of America and the Kingdom of Thailand on Reciprocal Trade(“ART”).
The ART will strengthen our bilateral economic relationship and will build upon our longstanding economic relationship, including theTreaty of Amity and Economic Relations Between the Kingdom of Thailand and the United States of America, signed in 1966, and theTrade and Investment Framework AgreementBetween the United States of America and the Kingdom of Thailand, signed in 2002.
The United States and Thailand will now begin their respective necessary internal processes to prepare the ART for signature and entry into force.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF the undersigned, being duly authorized thereto by their respective Governments, have signed this Joint Statement.
DONE in duplicate at Manila, in English, this 17th day of November, 2026.
For the Government of the For the Government of the
United States of America: Kingdom of Thailand:
Donald J. Trump Anutin Charnvirakul

On November 17, 2026 — President Donald J. Trump of the United States, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese of Australia, Prime Minister Narendra Modi of India, and Prime Minister Takaichi Sanae of Japan — met for a Quad Leaders’ Summit in Manila. This year marks nearly a decade since the Quad was revived and the tenth anniversary of the vision of a Free and Open Indo-Pacific, first articulated by the late Prime Minister Abe Shinzo of Japan in 2016. A decade on, that vision is stronger than ever. Together, we have shown that the Quad is a force for good and a partnership of action, committed to peace, stability, and prosperity. We strongly oppose any destabilizing or unilateral actions that seek to change the status quo, including by force or coercion, which escalate tensions and undermine regional peace and stability. We express grave concerns about economic coercion, including through arbitrary export restrictions. We are securing critical supply chains, protecting freedom of navigation and overflight, driving growth through technologies of the future including investments in and deployment of trusted Super Intelligence (SI)*, and responding to disasters with life-saving assistance. We commit to work together to ensure open, safe, and resilient maritime transit corridors in the Indo-Pacific. We are working with regional partners to tackle shared challenges and drive opportunities to deliver tangible benefits to the Indo-Pacific.
We reaffirm our unwavering support for ASEAN centrality and unity. Together, we are committed to upholding a free and open Indo-Pacific.
* In Australia, India, and Japan, ‘Super Intelligence’ refers to ‘artificial intelligence.’

item.description:

The White HouseNovember 17, 2026
Education is among the most important investments we make in America’s future, equipping the next generation with the knowledge, skills, and confidence to lead our country toward greater prosperity. This American Education Week, my Administration reaffirms its commitment to restoring greatness to our education system, ending the reign of far-left indoctrination in our classrooms, and empowering parents to choose the education that best suits their children’s needs and values.
For decades, American students, teachers, and parents faced an education system that failed to deliver the results they deserved. Since its inception in 1979, the Department of Education has managed to waste over 3 trillion taxpayer dollars without directly educating students or improving their academic performance. National assessments in recent years reveal alarming trends, with mathematics and reading scores plummeting as a result of nonsensical leftist policies and Federal Government ineffectiveness. Our children deserve better. These results underscore the urgent need to restore common sense to our classrooms and equip our students with the tools they need to build an independent and prosperous future.
Since I returned to office, my Administration has taken decisive action to advance a new era of academic excellence and return educational authority where it belongs: with States, parents, and local communities. Through historic Executive Orders expanding educational freedom and opportunity for families, we are reducing federal bureaucracy and putting students and families first. As part of that effort, I proudly directed the Secretary of Education to facilitate the closure of the Department of Education to put an end to the federal control that has failed generations of American children.
At the same time, my Executive Orders bar programs that receive Department of Education funds from advancing unlawful “Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion” mandates. Under my leadership, taxpayers will no longer be burdened with billions of dollars wasted on progressive social experiments and obsolete programs. We are delivering an education system that shifts the focus from dividing students by race and identity to uniting them around the timeless ideals of advancement through sheer hard work, merit, and excellence.
America’s greatness has always depended on the promise of the next generation. This week, we recognize the dedicated teachers, devoted parents, and hardworking students who form the foundation of our education system, and we promise them our unwavering commitment to building a system worthy of our Nation’s extraordinary potential. Together, we will restore greatness to our classrooms, renew confidence in American education, and ensure that every child has the opportunity to pursue their own unique American Dream.

item.description:

The White HouseNovember 19, 2026
On National Rural Health Day, we honor the doctors, nurses, first responders, caregivers, and other healthcare professionals who serve millions of Americans in rural communities across our country. Their work is essential to the strength of our Nation, and my Administration is committed to ensuring that Americans in every rural town receive high-quality healthcare, from the hills of Appalachia to the great Alaskan frontier.
For decades, career politicians treated rural America as an afterthought, and small-town families paid the price. Hospitals struggled to recruit enough doctors and nurses, and families were often forced to travel long distances to reach specialists and services that should have been available closer to home. Rural America should not have to trade its way of life for better health. The communities that feed our Nation and carry on our proudest traditions deserve a healthcare system that works for them.
Through the historic Working Families Tax Cuts Act, which every Democrat voted against, Republicans and I created the $50 billion Rural Health Transformation Program, a 5-year investment now at work in all 50 States, helping rural communities strengthen their healthcare workforce, modernize hospitals and clinics, expand access to telehealth, and bring more services closer to the patients who need them. The program puts States in charge, giving them the resources and flexibility to develop solutions that reflect the needs of their own communities.
This investment is also bringing a revolution of common sense to American health. Guided by our Make America Healthy Again agenda, it confronts the chronic disease crisis and puts prevention first, funding mobile clinics and screenings that catch illness early, remote monitoring that helps patients manage diabetes and high blood pressure from home, and nutrition and fitness programs that keep families thriving. Under my leadership, we will stop diseases before they ever take hold and give every citizen the chance to live a long, healthy life.
Today, we thank every healthcare professional who has chosen to serve rural America. Together, we are strengthening rural hospitals, improving access to care, and building a healthier future for the proud communities that feed, fuel, and defend our Nation. As we Make Rural America Healthy Again, our heartland will rise stronger, prouder, and greater than ever before.

On Friday, November 20, 2026, the President signed into law:
H.R. 10167, the “Common Cents Act,” which directs the Department of the Treasury to stop production of the penny except for collector needs; provides rounding guidance for cash transactions; allows the nickel to be composed of cost-saving materials; and provides procedures for the Secretary of the Treasury to follow to discontinue the production of any coin for general circulation.

item.title: First Lady Melania Trump Hails America’s Armed Forces
item.description:
Office of the First LadyFirst Lady Melania Trump Hails America’s Armed ForcesThe White HouseNovember 23, 2026

The White HouseNovember 23, 2026
Declaring precision and mental strength the foundation of global military superiority
As families across American prepare to celebrate Thanksgiving, First Lady Melania Trump addressed members of America’s armed forces at Joint Base Andrews, “The US military is the most powerful military in the world because of its people. Our warriors train relentlessly, pushing the boundaries of physical and mental strength.” Mrs. Trump analyzed, “Perfect precision is not an accident. It is the result of repetition, measured pacing, and flawless execution.”
First Lady Melania Trump has long been an ardent supporter of America’s military. Her unwavering commitment is reflected in her visit to an active combat zone in Iraq in 2018, her presence with grieving families of fallen American soldiers at Dover Air Force Base in March of 2026, and her presentation of a Purple Heart to a combat-wounded service member in 2019. Throughout her years of service as First Lady, Mrs. Trump has consistently championed military families, recognizing those who have been wounded or have made the ultimate sacrifice in defense of America.
Mrs. Trump brought a deeply personal dimension to America’s military as the enduring traditions of Thanksgiving mark the beginning of the holiday season, “But I know our military is not a machine. It’s made up of human beings, sons and daughters, who are taking on this inherently big risk.”
First Lady Melania Trump has been committed to peace throughout the world, recently securing a ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in Oleshky. Mrs. Trump explained, “The strength of our military helps us prevent wars. We perfect our capabilities to protect human life, preserve peace, and secure our nation’s future. This high level of precision of our Armed Forces sends an unmistakable message to the rest of the world: America’s children must inherit peace.”
First Lady Melania Trump’s remarks come just days before American families gather to celebrate Thanksgiving. Mrs. Trump also participated in assembling holiday care packages alongside military spouses, helping prepare special deliveries for service members deployed overseas. The long-standing, traditional event was made possible through the efforts of the American Red Cross.
First Lady Melania Trump’s full remarks, as prepared for delivery, are included below.
Remarks by First Lady Melania Trump
Thank you, Usha, for your kind words and for the dedication and service that you and the Vice President, a proud United States Marine veteran, have provided to our nation.
It is an honor to be welcomed by all of the members of our armed forces and their beautiful families here at Joint Base Andrews. I am delighted to share this special afternoon with you. And, thank you the spouses of our cabinet members who have joined me today to support America’s military.
Perfect precision is not an accident. It is the result of repetition, measured pacing, and flawless execution.
The US military is the most powerful military in the world because of its people. Our warriors train relentlessly, pushing the boundaries of physical and mental strength.
Every movement is deliberate. Everything is designed to achieve overpowering military superiority. Through relentless training, technical mastery, and a very measured approach to everything they do, our warriors make the very complex look effortless.
But I know our military is not a machine.
It’s made up of human beings, sons and daughters, who are taking on this inherently big risk. Our brave men and women have families who are praying for their safety every day. Those families know that absolute precision and coordination are vital to protecting the people they love. There is no room for mistakes.
Our warriors are united by a vison greater than themselves. Each individual contributes to a larger plan with their fellow warriors. They have unwavering trust in each other. There cannot be any accidents.
We must always remember that their service is not just about the transaction of a single mission. It is about the future of our children and grandchildren. It is about maintaining America’s lead position in the world, creating opportunities for American ingenuity and innovation, and preserving the safety and freedom of future generations. Our leaders don’t always talk about this, but we must always remember this is the end result of our military action.

On Monday, November 23, 2026, the President signed into law:
H.R. 1550, the “Strengthening America’s Turning Point Act,” which redesignates the Saratoga National Historical Park as the Saratoga National Battlefield Park;
H.R. 4930, which expands U.S. Customs and Border Protection’s authority to share information about imports suspected of violating United States intellectual-property-rights with the rights holders, online marketplaces, shippers, and other stakeholders; and
H.R. 8552, the “Veterans’ Compensation Cost-of-Living Adjustment Act of 2026,” which provides for a cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) for veterans’ disability compensation and dependency and indemnity compensation beneficiaries equal to the Social Security COLA.
